objective: Proof, written before the run: a fill makes a new crossing only if two different end knots of its certificate pin the two states; so fills certified with at most one end knot keep every relation of splits; MID2 and ONE keep two orders after the first fill from any line; from a full two-way grid the free form refills every new row; a split crossing nothing is never crossed again, so from a line the free form reaches a full grid exactly when the first fill spans it.
title: A crossing needs two end knots
